title: Offer to delete shortcuts to programs in notification (or window) if executable cannot be found
line: When an app in Kickoff, Kicker or KRunner can't start because its program was deleted, the error notification now has a "Remove from Menu" button.
explanation: Launching a menu entry whose program no longer exists (for example a deleted AppImage that had added itself to the menu) only showed "Could not find the program", and the stale entry could only be removed with the menu editor. A new small static library, plasma_applicationlauncher, now starts these launches for Kicker/Kickoff (app lists, favourites, recent apps) and the services runner (Kickoff search and KRunner). When the launch fails, the program is really missing and the .desktop file is the user's own in ~/.local/share/applications, it shows the same error notification with a "Remove from Menu" button that deletes that file; the menu updates through the normal sycoca rebuild.

commits.message:
kicker, services runner: offer to remove entries whose program is gone

A menu entry left behind by a deleted program, such as an AppImage, only
failed with a notification and had to be removed in the menu editor. Its
launch error now has a "Remove from Menu" button for the user's entries.

BUG: 463373

media.caption: Master: launching Synfig Studio whose AppImage was deleted only shows the error.

The stale Synfig Studio entry in Kickoff's Graphics category.
After pressing "Remove from Menu", the entry is gone from Kickoff.
